title: Report - Evening Post Vecherniaya Pochta, Russian Newspaper

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 5000-7-31

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE & S. B. REGISTRY. S. B. D. 2895. SECTION 2. Date December 22 - 1931）

Subject (in full) " EVENING POST" (" Vecherniaya Pochta" ), Russian Newspaper,

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

The publishing of the " Evening Post" ( " Vecherniaya
Pochta"), local Russian evening newspaper, the first issue of which
appeared on November 11, 1931, ceased on December 5 owing, it is re-
ported, to lack of funds.

Although it was anticipated that this newspaper
would be of a pro-Soviet character and in spite of the various
rumours which have been circulated regarding its editor's alleged
co-operation with agents of the U.S.S.R., including V.A.Rover, local
representative of the TASS Agency, - there is no evidence to this
effect and the general contents of the newspaper in question were
entirely of a non-political nature.

Information from a reliable source states that the
funds for the publishing of the " Evening Post" were supplied to
Preobrajensky, the editor, by N.A. Kolesnichenko, local lawyer, who
recently arrived here from Harbin. This individual forms the sub-
ject of file D.2787, concerning his previous connections with
the bolsheviks in Vladivostok.

According to an article which appeared recently in
one of the Russian newspapers in Harbin, it was mentioned that Ko-
lesnichenko upon his arrival in Shanghai had established a law
office in co-operation with Preobrajensky and was connected with
the newspaper " Evening Post". The article also denounced Kolesni-
chenko's former activity as Chief of Vladivostok police under
the Bolshevist rule. It is believed that in connection with this
article Kolesnichenko withdrew his financial support of the news-
paper, which had no alternative but to cease publication.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

（批：File 21.12.31）

报告

（印章：上海公共租界工部局警务处及特别处登记室。特别处 D. 2895。第2科。日期 1931年12月22日）

主题（全称）《晚报》（"Vecherniaya Pochta"），俄文报纸，

由 D.S. Prokofiev 制作 转呈人 （签名）

据报，本地俄文晚报《晚报》（"Vecherniaya Pochta"）因缺乏资金，已于12月5日停刊，该报首期于1931年11月11日出版。

尽管此前预计该报将具有亲苏维埃性质，且尽管流传着各种关于其编辑涉嫌与苏联代理人（包括塔斯社本地代表 V.A. Rover）合作的谣言，但并无证据证实此事，且该报的总体内容完全属于非政治性质。

来自可靠渠道的信息表明，《晚报》的出版资金由本地律师 N.A. Kolesnichenko 提供给编辑 Preobrajensky，此人最近刚从哈尔滨抵达上海。此人是档案 D.2787 的调查对象，该档案涉及其此前在符拉迪沃斯托克（海参崴）与布尔什维克的联系。

根据哈尔滨一家俄文报纸近期刊登的一篇文章提及，Kolesnichenko 抵达上海后，与 Preobrajensky 合作设立了一家律师事务所，并与《晚报》有关联。该文章还谴责了 Kolesnichenko 在布尔什维克统治时期担任符拉迪沃斯托克警察局长期间的过往活动。据信，鉴于这篇文章，Kolesnichenko 撤回了对该报的财政支持，导致该报别无选择，只能停止出版。

G. Prokofiev
D.S.

特别处主管警官。

（批注：归档 1931年12月21日）

page_data.en:
10/12/31
Translation from Chinese
(Original on file )

There has appeared in Shanghai a Soviet publication
entitled the "Evening Post" in which articles by the
communist spies Kanin (vide report dated the 13th), Kliorin,
Desth (vide report dated the 18th) and a lawyer Preobrajensky
who has been living in Shanghai for a long time and who has
become a Soviet citizen. The paper was censored and subsidized
by V. Rover. The paper is published in the Russian lan-
guage, but it is intended to supplement it with a Chinese-
English biplilingual edition in time to come. In accordance
with Rover's instructions the paper lends its support to all
anti-Japanese movements. The editorial and printing
departments of the paper are situated at No.1620 Haining Road
with a branch office at No.269 Avenue Joffre.

1931年12月10日
中文译文
（原件存档）

上海出现了一份名为《晚报》的苏维埃出版物，其中刊登了共产主义间谍 Kanin（见13日报告）、Kliorin、Desth（见18日报告）以及长期居住在上海并已加入苏联国籍的律师 Preobrajensky 的文章。该报由 V. Rover 审查并提供资助。该报以俄文出版，但计划在未来增出中英双语版。根据 Rover 的指示，该报支持所有反日运动。该报的编辑部和印刷部位于海宁路1620号，并在霞飞路269号设有分部。

page_data.en:
Extract from French Police Daily Intelligence
Report dated November 20,1931

Para 9.    N.F. Malinovsky,Russian journalist has no connection what-
ever with the publishing of the " Evening Post".
In contradiction to the information given in our report
of November 16,1931 ,p.1.,para 2, we learn that N.F.Malinov-
sky,editor of the Russian newspaper "GOLOSS"(The Voice ), al-
though he had been invited by N.Ireobrajensky to participate
in editing of his newspaper " Vecherniaya Pochta"( Evening
Post), refused to do so . He even refused to accept subscrip-
tions to this newspaper at the office of " GOLOSS".
( Vide our report dated November 14, p.1,para 1.)

第9段。俄国记者 N.F. Malinovsky 与《晚报》的出版毫无关联。
与我们1931年11月16日报告第1页第2段所提供的信息相反，我们获悉，俄文报纸《声音》（GOLOSS）的编辑 N.F. Malinovsky 虽然曾受 N. Preobrajensky 邀请参与其报纸《晚报》（Vecherniaya Pochta）的编辑工作，但予以拒绝。他甚至拒绝在《声音》报社接受对该报的订阅。
（参见我们11月14日的报告，第1页，第1段。）

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
S. B. D. 2895
18. 11. 31.

French Concession of Shanghai
Service of Police
Political Section

November 14, 1931

Official Report on Communist and Foreign
Activities in China
----------

Activity of Comintern and U.S.S.R. Agents

A new Russian newspaper appeared on November 11

The first issue of a new Russian evening paper, entitled
"Vetchernaya Potchta" (Evening Post), appeared on November 11.
The publishing and printing office of the newspaper are
located at 1620 Haining Road and a branch office has been
installed at 732 Seymour Road(Publishing office of the Russian
newspaper "Goloss", N.P. Malinovsky - vide our report dated
October 17, 1931, p.8, para.12). Subscriptions for the
paper and advertisements are accepted at Nos. 269 and 595
Avenue Joffre.
The chief editor of the newspaper is one N. Preobrajensky
lawyer, whose business dealings with the various local Soviet
agents have frequently formed the subject of our reports.
Preobrajensky is assisted by M. Kliorine, a journalist
attached to the local representation of the "Tass" Soviet
Agency, already mentioned in our preceding reports.
There is every reason to believe that this enterprise
is connected with V. Rover, local representative of "Tass".
It is to be recalled that Kliorine and I. Kounine have, on
several occasions, brought forward the question of the
publication of a Russian pro-Soviet newspaper in Shanghai,
which project is said to have met with the approval of V. Rov-
er (vide our report of October 10, p.2, para.5 and previous
reports).
It should, however, be noted that the two first numbers
of this newspaper, which we have in our possession, are in
novice pro-Soviet in character, but have anti-Japanese
tendencies.
Additional information regarding this publication will
be given in our forthcoming reports.

Rog.
a taken fil.
SB/1874

官方报告
----------

共产国际及苏联代理人的活动

11月11日出现了一份新的俄文报纸

11月11日，一份名为《Vetchernaya Potchta》（晚报）的新俄文晚报首期出版。该报的出版及印刷办公室位于海宁路1620号，并在西摩路732号设立了分部（俄文报纸《声音》的出版办公室，N.P. Malinovsky - 参见我们1931年10月17日的报告，第8页，第12段）。该报的订阅和广告受理点位于霞飞路269号和595号。
该报主编为律师 N. Preobrajensky，其与本地各苏联代理人的商业往来经常成为我们报告的主题。Preobrajensky 由 M. Kliorine 协助，后者是一名记者，隶属于此前报告中已提及的“塔斯社”苏联通讯社本地代表处。
有充分理由相信，该企业与“塔斯社”本地代表 V. Rover 有关联。需指出的是，Kliorine 和 I. Kounine 曾多次提出在上海出版一份亲苏维埃俄文报纸的问题，据说该项目已获得 V. Rover 的批准（参见我们10月10日的报告，第2页，第5段及之前的报告）。
然而，需要注意的是，我们要掌握的前两期报纸虽不具明显的亲苏维埃特征，但具有反日倾向。
关于该出版物的更多信息将在我们随后的报告中提供。

Rog.
a taken fil.
SB/1874

ACTIVITIES OF AGENTS OF THE KOMINTERN AND OF THE U.S.S.R.

Para. 2 Supplementary information regarding the Russian
newspaper "Evening Post".

Supplementary to the information given in our report
of November 14, page 1, para. 1, the premises No. 269 Avenue
Joffre, at which address subscription to the Russian
newspaper "VECHERNIAYA POCHTA" (Evening Post) was received,
according to announcement, - are occupied by a shop under the
style of the "New Department Store". The premises No. 595
Avenue Joffre (another address given for receiving subscrip-
tions) are occupied by the "Modes Parisiennes", a shop
belonging to Mrs. Korniloff. Mrs. Korniloff states that
she does not know anything regarding the newspaper and has no
intention of receiving subscriptions for it. N. P. Malinovsky,
Editor of the newspaper "GOLOS", officially joined the
editorial staff of the "Vecherniaya Pochta" to assist
N. A. Preobrajensky.

Subject (in full) "EVENING POST" ("Vecherniaya Pachta"), Russian Newspaper.

Made by D.S.Prokofiev Forwarded by （签名）

A new Russian evening newspaper entitled the " Evening
Post" ( " Vecherniaya Pochta") made its first appearance in Shanghai
on November 11. The editor is Mr.N.A. Preobrajensky, lawyer who oc-
cupies an office at Rm. 84, No 267 Avenue Joffre. A temporary edi-
torial office has been established in the premises of the Yah Shing
( 協 兴 ) Press, at No P-D 1621 Haining Road, by which concern
the paper is printed.

In the leading article of the first issue which con-
tains nothing of an objectionable nature, it is stated that the
newspaper will be at the service of the interests of Russian emi-
grants, the principal aims being:-
1) Furnishing information of practical and business
character to Russian emigrants arriving in Shanghai
in quest of employment; etc.,
2) Establishing, in connection with the newspaper, of
a Consultation and Information Bureau to render
practical assistance on the lines indicated above.

N.A.Preobrajensky forms the subject of file No 1.0.7926,
regarding his bolshevist leanings prior to coming to Shanghai in
1926. At that time he was reported to be in touch with the "Tass",
Soviet Telegraph Agency, and was connected with this agency for
some time. In 1928 he left for France on some political mission.
He returned to Shanghai in 1929 after which he resumed his work
with the "Tass" Agency. During the same year he obtained a post
as assistant in Mr.Franklin Chin's law office, No 21 Tsangchow Road.
Here he worked until 1931 when he established his own law office
at the above mentioned address. In 1929 he renounced his Soviet
nationality and applied for and secured an Emigrant's passport
from the Chinese Authorities.

主题（全称）《晚报》（"Vecherniaya Pachta"），俄文报纸。

由 D.S. Prokofiev 制作 转呈人 （签名）

一份名为《晚报》（"Vecherniaya Pochta"）的新俄文晚报于11月11日在上海首次亮相。编辑为 N.A. Preobrajensky 律师，其办公室位于霞飞路267号84室。临时编辑部设在协兴印务馆（Yah Shing Press）内，地址为海宁路 P-D 1621号，该报由该机构印刷。

在首期的社论中（不含任何令人反感的内容），声明该报将为俄国移民的利益服务，主要目标如下：
1) 向抵达上海寻找工作的俄国移民提供实用和商业性质的信息等；
2) 结合报纸业务，设立咨询与信息局，按上述方针提供实际援助。

N.A. Preobrajensky 是档案第 1.O.7926 号的调查对象，涉及其1926年来到上海之前的布尔什维克倾向。当时据报道，他与苏联电报局“塔斯社”保持联系，并与该机构有过一段时间的关联。1928年，他因某种政治任务前往法国。1929年他返回上海，随后恢复了与“塔斯社”的工作关系。同年，他在福州路21号 Franklin Chin 先生的律师事务所获得助理职位。他在此工作至1931年，随后在上述地址开设了自己的律师事务所。1929年，他放弃了苏联国籍，并向中国当局申请并获得了流亡者护照。

N. PREOBRAJENSKY
LAWYER
BEARN APT., 267 AVE. JOFFRE, FL. 84
TEL. 72456
SHANGHAI

Shanghai, November 14-th 1931.

The Inspector
in charge of
Haining Road Station.

Sir,

I beg to inform you that I have from the 11-th instant established
the daily evening newspaper "Vecherniaya Pochta" with offices and printing
press temporarily at 1620 Haining road, and the object is to furnish the
Russian reading public with general news, information, stories, etc.,
without any political leaning. If it should publish any political articles
it will be decidedly anti-Soviet.

I beg to remain,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,
N. Preobrajensky
Editor.

※ See also
D. 1647 & 10. 7926 & 9573.

先生，

谨此通知阁下，本人自本月11日起创办日报《晚报》（Vecherniaya Pochta），办事处及印刷所暂设于海宁路1620号，旨在为俄语读者提供一般新闻、资讯、故事等，不带任何政治倾向。若刊登任何政治文章，必将持坚决的反苏维埃立场。

此致，
敬礼

N. Preobrajensky
